# vcp_gateways (Data Source)

Fetches the list of all gateways in the project.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# List all gateways in the project.
data "vcp_gateways" "all" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `gateways` (Attributes List) List of gateways. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--gateways))

<a id="nestedatt--gateways"></a>
### Nested Schema for `gateways`

Read-Only:

- `created` (String) Creation timestamp.
- `firewall_rules` (Attributes List) Firewall rules of the gateway, in evaluation order — the **last** matching rule wins. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--gateways--firewall_rules))
- `id` (String) Gateway ID.
- `isolated_net_nics` (Attributes List) Isolated networks connected to the gateway. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--gateways--isolated_net_nics))
- `location_id` (String) Location ID.
- `name` (String) Gateway name.
- `nat_rules` (Attributes List) NAT rules of the gateway, in the order the API stores them (which rule wins when several of them match is not specified by the API documentation). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--gateways--nat_rules))
- `powered_on` (Boolean) Whether the gateway is powered on.
- `public_net_nics` (Attributes List) External (WAN) interfaces of the gateway. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--gateways--public_net_nics))
- `state` (String) Gateway state.
- `tags` (Set of String) Set of tags.

<a id="nestedatt--gateways--firewall_rules"></a>
### Nested Schema for `gateways.firewall_rules`

Read-Only:

- `action` (String) Action (Allow, Deny).
- `destination` (String) Destination in CIDR notation.
- `destination_port` (Number) Destination port (0 = any).
- `direction` (String) Direction (In, Out).
- `protocol` (String) Protocol (TCP, UDP, ICMP, IP).
- `source` (String) Source in CIDR notation.
- `source_port` (Number) Source port (0 = any).


<a id="nestedatt--gateways--isolated_net_nics"></a>
### Nested Schema for `gateways.isolated_net_nics`

Read-Only:

- `id` (Number) NIC ID.
- `ip_address` (String) IP address assigned on the network.
- `network_id` (String) Connected isolated network ID.


<a id="nestedatt--gateways--nat_rules"></a>
### Nested Schema for `gateways.nat_rules`

Read-Only:

- `destination` (String) Destination in CIDR notation.
- `destination_port` (Number) Destination port (0 = any).
- `protocol` (String) Protocol (TCP, UDP, ICMP, IP).
- `source` (String) Source in CIDR notation.
- `translated` (String) Address the traffic is translated to.
- `translated_port` (Number) Port after translation (0 = any).
- `type` (String) Rule type (SNAT, DNAT, BINAT).


<a id="nestedatt--gateways--public_net_nics"></a>
### Nested Schema for `gateways.public_net_nics`

Read-Only:

- `bandwidth_mbps` (Number) Uplink bandwidth in Mbps.
- `id` (Number) NIC ID.
- `ip_address` (String) Public IP address.
